4169112.title: Pile of Parts
4169112.content:
After some work identifying them, all of these seem to be parts of a golem's hand. Each one has been carefully dismantled, but, for some reason, they were put away without much thought.
 Speaking of which, where did the other parts go?

4169112.content:
鑑識したが、これらは恐らくすべて魔像の手のパーツだろう。どれも丁寧に取り外されているが、積み方はとても適当に見える。
 そういえば、他のパーツはどうしたのだろう？
